You bring your story. We bring the structure to make sense of it.

quotes.text: Primrose was founded by two female psychiatrists and mothers who witnessed firsthand how mental health needs — particularly during perinatal care, reproductive transitions, midlife changes, and the pressures of parenthood and work — are too often overlooked.
We listen, avoid rushing, and work with you on various concerns, including women's health psychiatry, ADHD, autism, and both child and adult psychiatry.

Dr. Parisa Loxham is a Consultant Psychiatrist specializing in child psychiatry, adult psychiatry, and women's health psychiatry, dedicated to providing quality evidence-based care through a kind, whole-person approach.
Her approach integrates pharmacological treatments with psychodynamic insights and lifestyle-informed guidance that is practical, supportive, and tailored to real-life circumstances.

Dr. Loxham completed her medical degree and early clinical training in the United Kingdom before specializing in psychiatry at the Princess Alexandra Hospital and the Queensland Children's Hospital in Brisbane.

These qualifications enhance her understanding of the interplay between movement, stress, energy, and physical routines with emotional health, enriching her psychiatric practice with a grounded, holistic perspective.
She is a member of the Australian ADHD Professionals Association and has also provided formal education to GPs to enhance ADHD care.
